title: AI experts urge slower pace, more safeguards
description: SAN FRANCISCO -- More than a dozen top artificial intelligence researchers warned over the last week that the technology that AI companies are building is becoming a risk to humanity. title: Xi Jinping’s five-point BRICS plan puts China’s tech ambitions in spotlight
description: China's President Xi Jinping proposed five initiatives for BRICS cooperation next year. These proposals focus on artificial intelligence and digital industries for economic growth. China will lead in establishing an AI open-source community and a digital ecosystem cloud platform. Initiatives also aim to facilitate trade, build smart factories, and develop science talent. Xi also called for defending international law and upholding sovereign equality among nations.
